999008199.text:
隠し階段を、下がって、上がって……
はぁ、はぁっ……もうわけ分かんないんだけど！

localizations.en: Down the hidden stairs, then up, then down again... Hah, hah... I don't even know where we are anymore!

999008199.text:
いつの間にか夜になってるし……
ここはどこなんだろう？

localizations.en: It's already nighttime somehow... Where are we?

999008199.text:
あっ！　あそこにいるの、ヴァレリアじゃない！？
おーい！

localizations.en: Oh! Isn't that Valeria over there?! Hey!

999008199.text:
レスナ！　アルビーナも！
無事にみんな助け出せたのね！

localizations.en: Resna! Alvina too! You managed to rescue everyone safely!

999008199.text:
コウセンらしき人影が、上の階へと逃げていった！
このまま追い詰めるぞ！

localizations.en: A figure resembling Kosen fled to the upper floor! We'll corner him now!

999008199.text: うん……って、九偉人！？

localizations.en: Yeah... wait, one of the Nine?!

999008199.text:
さっきからレスナと一緒にアタシらもいたんだけど
気付いてなかったのかい？

localizations.en: I've been with Resna and the others this whole time, but you didn't notice?

999008199.text:
ほんとだ！
イェルカに……げっ、シトリンも

localizations.en: You're right! Jelka and... ugh, it's Citrine too.

999008199.text: なんだよ、せっかく助けに来てあげたのに

localizations.en: What's with that reaction? I came to help rescue you.

999008199.text:
よく分からないが……
コウセンを倒すという目的は同じと考えていいのかな？

localizations.en: I'm not sure what's going on, but... we all share the same goal of defeating Kosen, right?

999008199.text: ララ殿は？
鏑矢の様子を看てる。千歳も一緒よ

localizations.en: She's looking after Kaburaya. Chitose is with her too.

999008199.text: え！？　鏑矢さん、どうなったの？

きっと今頃、正気に戻ってくれてるはずよ。
アルビーナたちが託してくれたレシピのおかげでね

localizations.en: She should have regained her senses by now. Thanks to the recipe you entrusted to us.

999008199.text:
そっか、よかったあ……
それじゃあ、後はコウセンだけか

localizations.en: I see, that's a relief... So now it's just Kosen left.

999008199.text: 行きましょう、上へ！
や、やっとたどり着いたか……
追い詰めたよ、コウセン！！
浜辺の時みたいにはいかないわよ！

localizations.en: This won't go like it did at the beach!

999008199.text:
追い詰めた？　違うな。
おびき寄せたのだ

localizations.en: Cornered? No. I lured you here.

999008199.text: なっ！　式神だと！？
偽者だったの！？
ならば、本体はいずこに……

localizations.en: Then where is the real Kosen...

999008199.text: ここだ

陰陽の力を施したこの場でなら
我は本来の何倍もの力が出せる

localizations.en: In this place infused with onmyoji power, I can exert many times my normal strength.

999008199.text:
むぅ……確かにとてつもない陰陽の力だ。
そして微かに混ざるのは、物の怪の臭い……！

localizations.en: Mmm... that's certainly tremendous onmyoji power. And there's something else mixed in—the scent of demons...!

999008199.text: コウセンは魔物だったってこと！？

localizations.en: So Kosen was a monster all along?!

999008199.text:
この姿を見せるのは鏑矢に復讐を果たす時と
決めていたのだがな……

localizations.en: I had decided to show this form only when I would have my revenge on Kaburaya...

999008199.text: これは……まさか、大蛇！？

localizations.en: This is... could it be, the great serpent?!

999008199.text: それって、鏑矢が昔退治したっていう……

localizations.en: You mean the one Kaburaya defeated long ago...

999008199.text: 左様、我は鏑矢に討ち果たされた大蛇の父……！

localizations.en: Indeed, I am the father of the great serpent slain by Kaburaya...!

999008199.text:
我が子を殺された恨み、このケイウン全土を
滅ぼして回っても晴れはせんわ！

localizations.en: The hatred for my child's murder will not be satisfied even if I destroy all of Keiun!

999008199.text:
長年生きた妖怪は人語を解して
人をたぶらかす……まさにその通りね！

localizations.en: Ancient demons that live long lives can speak human words and deceive people... You're exactly that!

999008199.text:
境遇には同情しますけど……
だからって許せません！

localizations.en: I sympathize with your circumstances, but... that doesn't make this forgivable!

999008199.text:
誰が許してくれと言ったか！
許さぬのはこちらのほうよ！！

localizations.en: Who asked for forgiveness?! I'm the one who won't forgive!!

999008199.text:
コウセン……
これ以上の狼藉は許しませぬ

localizations.en: Kosen... we cannot allow any more of your violence.

999008199.text:
鏑矢を騙し、この国を混乱に陥れた、
その報いを受けてもらう！

localizations.en: You deceived Kaburaya and threw this country into chaos. You must face the consequences!

999008199.text: フン……この我を倒せるとでも？

localizations.en: Hah... you think you can defeat me?

999008199.text:
なかなか、しぶといわね……
これがケイウン大妖怪の力！

localizations.en: Pretty stubborn... This is the power of Keiun's great demon!

999008199.text:
でも、こいつを倒さないと何も解決しない！
怖いけどやらなきゃ……！

localizations.en: But if we don't defeat this thing, nothing will be resolved! I'm scared, but we have to do this...!

999008199.text:
もう、やめませんか。
これ以上戦う必要なんて……

localizations.en: Can't you stop this? There's no need to fight anymore...

999008199.text:
すでに勝ったつもりか？
人間風情が……自惚れるな

localizations.en: Already think you've won? Don't get cocky, you mere humans...
